the paleomagnetic inclination, declination and paleointensity records from North American lake sediments are in substantial agreement with those of lava flows and potsherd collections.
(1) paleomagnetic records obtained from lake sediments can be used to correlate paleoclimatic records and (2) these records can be used to date paleoclimatic events when 14C dating cannot.

the use of paleomagnetic records for correlation and dating purposes, and the use of paleointensity records for the study of geomagnetic variations, atmospheric radiocarbon, and the relationship of geomagnetism to climate.
